title: Checkout retries collide during elevated latency
summary: Checkout confirmations lag and a small share of requests return duplicate-operation errors.
precursor: Payment confirmation latency rose during a promotion, causing clients and workers to retry submissions inside the same idempotency window.
impact: Some customers see an uncertain checkout result and retry again, increasing support contacts and duplicate payment investigations.

title: Supplier catalog batches partially apply
summary: Catalog synchronization reports rejected item groups while storefront availability remains stale.
precursor: A supplier feed began including variant records before all referenced product records were present in the same import window.
impact: New or changed variants are missing from storefront listings until the affected groups are replayed.

title: Ledger writes queue behind a long transaction
summary: Ledger write latency climbs and API workers accumulate while waiting for transactions to finish.
precursor: A month-end aging report began scanning a large tenant partition as invoice posting traffic returned to its usual peak.
impact: Invoice issuance and balance updates miss their service targets, with a growing queue of pending billing events.

title: Analytics exports fail after a worker rollout
summary: Scheduled exports stop completing after deployment, leaving several operational dashboards behind.
precursor: The exporter deployment progressed while the database change for the next reporting revision was still pending in the release sequence.
impact: Finance and operations teams continue to see yesterday's totals until export jobs recover and catch up.

title: Order connection pool cannot re-establish sessions
summary: Order writes begin returning transient service errors as new database sessions fail immediately.
precursor: A database node failover occurred while writer pods were scaling up to drain a delayed order-event backlog.
impact: New orders are delayed and the event backlog continues to grow until database connectivity is restored.
